name: 副腎脳白質ジストロフィー脊髄型

summary.text: A form of the peroxisomal disease X-linked adrenoleukodystrophy, characterized by progressive myelopathy and peripheral neuropathy, and often associated with peripheral adrenal insufficiency in males. Onset is typically in adulthood.
summary.evidence: A form of the peroxisomal disease X-link
